verdict.rationale: CrewAI's Flows feature is explicitly documented as an event-driven workflow system that connects tasks, manages state, and controls execution flow automatically based on events, and Enterprise adds webhook streaming to push real-time events to external systems. This directly matches the 'define rules that trigger actions on events' story via first-party framework primitives (event-driven Flows) plus enterprise webhook automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of event-triggered automation in practice, and detailed docs on specific event/listener decorators beyond high-level description.
